label: Get member values
description: Read what one member gave for the fields the program writes `@member_filled` (their model, their sheet, their schedule, their connection). A field they left empty is not listed: a run for them uses its fallback, or the node's default. For a manager's overview of each member's settings, or to decide something from them.

inputs.name: member
inputs.description: The member, by the id your program uses for them (`user-42`).

outputs.name: values
outputs.description: What they gave, by `node.field` the way the program writes it, the same keys `SetMemberValues` takes: `{"answer.model": "deepseek/deepseek-chat", "digest.cron": "0 0 7 * * *"}`. A connection reads as its `{"id", "identity"}` handle.
